newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian job vacancies rise 2.7 pct in May qtr.
newsitem.headline: Australian job vacancies rise 2.7 pct in May qtr.

text.p: Australian job vacancies rose a seasonally adjusted 2.7 percent in the three months to May, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
The May rise followed a 0.9 percent fall in the three months to February.
May job vacancies stood 7.7 percent higher than a year ago.
Trend data showed a 1.4 percent rise in vacancies in the quarter and a 6.0 percent rise over the year.
Overtime worked by the average overtime-working employee fell 0.9 percent in the quarter in seasonally adjusted terms and was 3.6 percent lower than its level of a year before.
Trend overtime for overtime workers rose 0.1 percent in the quarter and was fell 1.6 percent on May 1996.
